DPast Perfect Continuous Tense · Answer the questions about the text.

Last Thursday, Ece visited a school well-being workshop. Before she arrived, she had been working on her project for two hours. Her eyes felt tired because she had been looking at her screen. At the workshop, Arda explained self-care and balanced nutrition. Selin showed a breathing exercise. Mert suggested regular breaks and outdoor activities. Ece took notes instead of using her phone. By the time she went home, she had made a simple plan: more water, short walks and a steady bedtime routine.
  1. 1

    Which day did Ece visit the workshop?

  2. 2

    Where did she go?

  3. 3

    How long had she been working?

  4. 4

    What had she been working on?

  5. 5

    How did her eyes feel?

  6. 6

    Why did her eyes feel tired?

  7. 7

    Who explained self-care?

  8. 8

    What nutrition topic did Arda explain?

  9. 9

    Who showed a breathing exercise?

  10. 10

    Who suggested regular breaks?

  11. 11

    What kind of activities did Mert suggest?

  12. 12

    Did Ece use her phone to take notes?

  13. 13

    What had she made by the time she went home?

  14. 14

    Name one activity in her plan.

  15. 15

    What kind of bedtime routine did she plan?
